cohort: 184,611 women who became pregnant after participating in the National Pre-pregnancy Checkups Project in China from 2010 to 2012
finding: Elevated preconception TSH levels, even within the normal nonpregnant range, were associated with an increased risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes such as spontaneous abortion, preterm birth, and caesarean section.
mod_finding: Preconception TSH elevation was associated with an increased risk of operative vaginal delivery and cesarean section.
